name: side-roll-left
description: Lateral roll, LEFT shoulder. Same policy as side-roll-right; the daemon feeds idle [0,-1,0] so the two-button policy rolls left. Lands back in the start posture.

command.twist: Same two-button policy as side-roll-right; this repo's daemon feeds twist [0,-1,0] so it rolls LEFT. Start standing OR seated - the policy returns to its start posture.
